entries.title: BonVoyage configuration
entries.summary: The complete declarative desired state compiled into one immutable BonVoyage snapshot.

entries.title: Clusters
entries.summary: The non-empty set of named upstream service pools available to routes.

entries.title: Active health checks
entries.summary: Optional periodic HTTP health probing for endpoints in this cluster.

entries.title: Maximum healthy status
entries.summary: The inclusive highest HTTP response status considered healthy by an active probe.

entries.title: Minimum healthy status
entries.summary: The inclusive lowest HTTP response status considered healthy by an active probe.

entries.title: Healthy threshold
entries.summary: The consecutive successful probes required before an endpoint becomes healthy.

entries.title: Health-check host
entries.summary: The HTTP Host or authority value used by active health-check requests.

entries.title: Health-check interval
entries.summary: The delay in milliseconds between scheduled active health probes.

entries.title: Health-check path
entries.summary: The absolute HTTP request path used for active health probes.

entries.title: Health-check timeout
entries.summary: The maximum time in milliseconds allowed for one active health probe.

entries.title: Unhealthy threshold
entries.summary: The consecutive failed probes required before an endpoint becomes unhealthy.

entries.title: Connect timeout
entries.summary: The maximum time in milliseconds allowed to establish an upstream connection.

entries.title: DNS refresh
entries.summary: Optional bounded asynchronous hostname-resolution policy for cluster endpoints.

entries.title: DNS refresh interval
entries.summary: The interval in milliseconds between accepted endpoint hostname refreshes.

entries.title: DNS resolution timeout
entries.summary: The maximum time in milliseconds allowed for one endpoint hostname resolution.

entries.title: Endpoints
entries.summary: The non-empty set of upstream network destinations owned by this cluster.

entries.title: Endpoint address
entries.summary: The IP address or hostname used to connect to this upstream endpoint.

entries.title: Endpoint name
entries.summary: The unique stable name of this endpoint within its cluster.

entries.title: Endpoint port
entries.summary: The TCP port used to connect to this upstream endpoint.

entries.title: Endpoint weight
entries.summary: The relative endpoint selection weight used by a compatible load-balancing policy.

entries.title: Load-balancing policy
entries.summary: The reviewed algorithm used to select an eligible endpoint for each request.

entries.title: Endpoint request limit
entries.summary: The maximum concurrent requests admitted to one endpoint before bounded rejection or alternate selection.

entries.title: Connections per shard
entries.summary: The maximum shard-local upstream connections retained for this cluster.

entries.title: HTTP/2 streams per connection
entries.summary: The maximum concurrent HTTP/2 streams admitted on one upstream connection.

entries.title: Pending requests per shard
entries.summary: The maximum shard-local requests allowed to wait for upstream capacity.

entries.title: Cluster name
entries.summary: The unique stable cluster name referenced by routes and weighted-cluster entries.

entries.title: Passive health
entries.summary: Optional endpoint ejection and recovery policy driven by proxied request outcomes.

entries.title: Failure threshold
entries.summary: The consecutive qualifying failures required before passive endpoint ejection.

entries.title: Recovery threshold
entries.summary: The consecutive successful observations required before passive recovery.

entries.title: Ejection duration
entries.summary: The bounded time in milliseconds an unhealthy endpoint remains passively ejected.

entries.title: Maximum ejection percentage
entries.summary: The maximum percentage of cluster endpoints that passive health may eject at once.

entries.title: Upstream protocol
entries.summary: The application protocol BonVoyage uses when forwarding requests to this cluster.

entries.title: Retry policy
entries.summary: Optional bounded retry behavior for eligible failures and request methods.

entries.title: Retry budget
entries.summary: Shard-local token and concurrency limits that contain retry amplification.

entries.title: Retry budget capacity
entries.summary: The maximum number of retry tokens retained by the shard-local budget.

entries.title: Concurrent retries per shard
entries.summary: The maximum retries executing concurrently on one data-plane shard.

entries.title: Retry token refill
entries.summary: The number of retry-budget tokens replenished per second on each shard.

entries.title: Maximum attempts
entries.summary: The total bounded upstream attempts permitted for one eligible request.

entries.title: Per-try timeout
entries.summary: The maximum time in milliseconds allowed for each individual upstream attempt.

entries.title: Retryable methods
entries.summary: The explicit HTTP methods eligible for this cluster retry policy.

entries.title: Upstream TLS
entries.summary: TLS server verification and optional client-certificate settings for this cluster.

entries.title: Client certificate secret
entries.summary: The deployment-secret filename containing the client certificate chain used for upstream mTLS.

entries.title: Client private-key secret
entries.summary: The deployment-secret filename containing the private key used for upstream mTLS.

entries.title: TLS server name
entries.summary: The expected upstream server identity used for SNI and certificate verification.

entries.title: Upstream trust-bundle secret
entries.summary: The deployment-secret filename containing trusted certificate authorities for the upstream server.

entries.title: Listeners
entries.summary: The non-empty set of downstream network listeners exposed by the gateway.

entries.title: Listener address
entries.summary: The local network address on which this listener accepts downstream connections.

entries.title: Downstream TLS
entries.summary: TLS certificate and optional client-authentication settings for this listener.

entries.title: Server certificate secret
entries.summary: The deployment-secret filename containing the listener certificate chain.

entries.title: Server private-key secret
entries.summary: The deployment-secret filename containing the listener private key.

entries.title: Require client certificate
entries.summary: Whether the listener requires and verifies a downstream client certificate.

entries.title: Client trust-bundle secret
entries.summary: The deployment-secret filename containing authorities trusted for downstream client certificates.

entries.title: Listener name
entries.summary: The unique stable name of this listener within the snapshot.

entries.title: Listener port
entries.summary: The TCP port on which this listener accepts downstream connections.

entries.title: Listener protocol
entries.summary: The downstream HTTP protocol accepted by this listener.

entries.title: Trusted proxy policy
entries.summary: The explicit proxy-network boundary allowed to supply trusted forwarded client identity.

entries.title: Trusted proxy networks
entries.summary: The bounded CIDR set whose forwarded client-address metadata may be trusted.

entries.title: Listener virtual hosts
entries.summary: The names of virtual hosts bound to this listener.

entries.title: Runtime limits
entries.summary: Optional global safety ceilings applied by the data plane for this snapshot.

entries.title: Downstream idle timeout
entries.summary: The maximum downstream connection idle period in milliseconds.

entries.title: Downstream connections per shard
entries.summary: The maximum downstream connections admitted by one data-plane shard.

entries.title: Maximum request body
entries.summary: The global maximum accepted downstream request-body size in bytes.

entries.title: Maximum request headers
entries.summary: The global maximum accepted downstream request-header size in bytes.

entries.title: Maximum chunk metadata
entries.summary: The maximum upstream chunk-metadata bytes retained while processing a response.

entries.title: Maximum response headers
entries.summary: The maximum accepted upstream response-header size in bytes.

entries.title: Request timeout
entries.summary: The global maximum request lifetime in milliseconds unless a stricter boundary applies.

entries.title: Server identity
entries.summary: Local node identity and administrative bind addresses for this gateway process.

entries.title: Admin address
entries.summary: The local address used by the gateway administrative endpoint.

entries.title: Metrics address
entries.summary: The local address used to expose Prometheus metrics.

entries.title: Node ID
entries.summary: The stable identity reported by this gateway node to management and observability surfaces.

entries.title: Snapshot metadata
entries.summary: Version and identity metadata bound to the compiled immutable configuration artifact.

entries.title: Snapshot generation
entries.summary: A positive operator-controlled generation used to order desired-state revisions.

entries.title: Minimum data-plane version
entries.summary: The minimum BonVoyage data-plane version declared compatible with this snapshot.

entries.title: Configuration schema version
entries.summary: The configuration schema version interpreted by the installed compiler; contract v1 supports version 1.

entries.title: Snapshot ID
entries.summary: The stable operator-visible identifier assigned to this desired-state snapshot.

entries.title: Virtual hosts
entries.summary: The non-empty set of domain-routing tables available to listeners.

entries.title: Virtual-host domains
entries.summary: The domain patterns matched by this virtual host.

entries.title: Virtual-host name
entries.summary: The unique stable virtual-host name referenced by listeners.

entries.title: Routes
entries.summary: The ordered non-empty route table evaluated within this virtual host.

entries.title: API-key authentication
entries.summary: Optional API-key admission policy evaluated before an upstream request is sent.

entries.title: API-key credentials secret
entries.summary: The deployment-secret filename containing the accepted API-key credential set.

entries.title: API-key header
entries.summary: The downstream HTTP header from which the API key is read.

entries.title: Route cluster
entries.summary: The single named upstream cluster selected by this route.

entries.title: CORS policy
entries.summary: Optional cross-origin request and response policy for this route.

entries.title: Allow any origin
entries.summary: Whether any syntactically valid origin is accepted by this CORS policy.

entries.title: Allow credentials
entries.summary: Whether CORS responses permit downstream credentials under the configured origin policy.

entries.title: Allowed request headers
entries.summary: The bounded request-header names allowed by CORS preflight handling.

entries.title: Allowed CORS methods
entries.summary: The HTTP methods allowed by this route's CORS policy.

entries.title: Allowed origins
entries.summary: The explicit origin values accepted when any-origin mode is disabled.

entries.title: Exposed response headers
entries.summary: The response-header names exposed to browser clients by CORS.

entries.title: Preflight maximum age
entries.summary: The maximum number of seconds a browser may cache a successful CORS preflight.

entries.title: Fixed response
entries.summary: A gateway-generated response action that does not contact an upstream cluster.

entries.title: Fixed-response body
entries.summary: The optional response body returned by this fixed-response action.

entries.title: Fixed-response content type
entries.summary: The optional media type returned with this fixed response.

entries.title: Fixed-response status
entries.summary: The HTTP status code returned by this fixed-response action.

entries.title: Header transformations
entries.summary: Ordered request and response header mutations for an upstream route.

entries.title: Request header mutations
entries.summary: The ordered bounded mutations applied before forwarding an upstream request.

entries.title: Request header name
entries.summary: The normalized HTTP field name targeted by this request mutation.

entries.title: Request mutation operation
entries.summary: Whether this request mutation sets, appends, or removes the selected header.

entries.title: Request header value
entries.summary: The bounded value used by a request set or append mutation; remove uses no value.

entries.title: Response header mutations
entries.summary: The ordered bounded mutations applied before returning an upstream response.

entries.title: Response header name
entries.summary: The normalized HTTP field name targeted by this response mutation.

entries.title: Response mutation operation
entries.summary: Whether this response mutation sets, appends, or removes the selected header.

entries.title: Response header value
entries.summary: The bounded value used by a response set or append mutation; remove uses no value.

entries.title: JWT authentication
entries.summary: Optional signed JWT admission policy evaluated before upstream selection.

entries.title: JWT algorithms
entries.summary: The explicit accepted JWT signature algorithms for this route.

entries.title: JWT audience
entries.summary: The required audience claim for tokens admitted by this route.

entries.title: JWT clock skew
entries.summary: The bounded time tolerance in seconds applied to JWT time claims.

entries.title: JWT issuer
entries.summary: The required HTTPS issuer identity for tokens admitted by this route.

entries.title: JWKS secret
entries.summary: The deployment-secret filename containing the reviewed JSON Web Key Set used for signature verification.

entries.title: Maximum token lifetime
entries.summary: The maximum accepted JWT lifetime in seconds.

entries.title: Required JWT claims
entries.summary: The bounded set of additional exact claim matches required for admission.

entries.title: Required claim value
entries.summary: The exact bounded value required for this additional JWT claim.

entries.title: Required claim name
entries.summary: The non-reserved JWT claim name evaluated by this exact match.

entries.title: Required JWT scopes
entries.summary: The bounded set of scopes that an admitted token must contain.

entries.title: Required JWT type
entries.summary: The required token type value accepted by this route.

entries.title: JWT verification rate limit
entries.summary: A shard-local token bucket that bounds cryptographic verification work.

entries.title: Verification capacity
entries.summary: The maximum verification tokens retained by each shard-local bucket.

entries.title: Verification token refill
entries.summary: The number of JWT verification tokens replenished per second on each shard.

entries.title: Local rate limit
entries.summary: An optional shard-local token bucket applied to this route.

entries.title: Rate-limit capacity
entries.summary: The maximum request tokens retained by each shard-local route bucket.

entries.title: Rate-limit token refill
entries.summary: The number of route-admission tokens replenished per second on each shard.

entries.title: Route match
entries.summary: The path and optional method, header, and query conditions that select this route.

entries.title: Header matchers
entries.summary: The bounded set of downstream request-header predicates required by this route.

entries.title: Exact header value
entries.summary: The exact bounded header value required when this matcher uses value equality.

entries.title: Matched header name
entries.summary: The HTTP request-header name evaluated by this matcher.

entries.title: Header presence
entries.summary: Whether the selected request header must be present or absent.

entries.title: Matched methods
entries.summary: The optional explicit HTTP method set accepted by this route.

entries.title: Exact path match
entries.summary: An absolute request path that must match exactly.

entries.title: Path-prefix match
entries.summary: An absolute request-path prefix used to select this route.

entries.title: Query-parameter matchers
entries.summary: The bounded set of query-parameter predicates required by this route.

entries.title: Exact query value
entries.summary: The exact bounded query-parameter value required by this matcher.

entries.title: Matched query name
entries.summary: The query-parameter name evaluated by this matcher.

entries.title: Query presence
entries.summary: Whether the selected query parameter must be present or absent.

entries.title: Safe regular-expression match
entries.summary: A bounded RE2-compatible request-path expression used to select this route.

entries.title: Route concurrency per shard
entries.summary: The maximum requests concurrently admitted to this route on one shard.

entries.title: Route name
entries.summary: The unique stable route name within its virtual host.

entries.title: Redirect response
entries.summary: A gateway-generated HTTP redirect action that does not contact an upstream cluster.

entries.title: Redirect host
entries.summary: The optional normalized host used to construct the redirect target.

entries.title: Redirect path
entries.summary: The absolute non-network-path redirect target path.

entries.title: Redirect port
entries.summary: The optional TCP port included in the redirect authority.

entries.title: Redirect query
entries.summary: The optional query component appended to the redirect target without a leading question mark.

entries.title: Redirect scheme
entries.summary: The optional HTTP or HTTPS scheme used with an explicit redirect host.

entries.title: Redirect status
entries.summary: The supported 3xx HTTP status returned by this redirect action.

entries.title: Request-content policy
entries.summary: Optional request media-type and body-size admission rules for this route.

entries.title: Allowed content types
entries.summary: The explicit media types accepted by this route's request-content policy.

entries.title: Route body limit
entries.summary: The maximum request-body size in bytes accepted by this route.

entries.title: Route rewrite
entries.summary: Optional upstream authority or path rewriting applied after route selection.

entries.title: Rewritten host
entries.summary: The normalized upstream host used after this rewrite.

entries.title: Rewritten exact path
entries.summary: The absolute path that replaces the complete matched request path.

entries.title: Rewritten path prefix
entries.summary: The absolute prefix that replaces the matched route prefix while preserving the suffix.

entries.title: Rewritten port
entries.summary: The optional upstream authority port used with a rewritten host.

entries.title: Source-IP policy
entries.summary: Optional allow or deny CIDR admission based on the resolved downstream client address.

entries.title: Allowed source networks
entries.summary: The CIDR set from which resolved client addresses are admitted.

entries.title: Denied source networks
entries.summary: The CIDR set from which resolved client addresses are rejected.

entries.title: WebSocket policy
entries.summary: Enables bounded WebSocket upgrade and forwarding behavior for an upstream route.

entries.title: WebSocket idle timeout
entries.summary: The maximum idle period in milliseconds for an upgraded WebSocket connection.

entries.title: Weighted clusters
entries.summary: The bounded set of named clusters and relative weights used for deterministic traffic distribution.

entries.title: Weighted cluster name
entries.summary: The named upstream cluster represented by this weighted entry.

entries.title: Cluster weight
entries.summary: The positive relative traffic weight assigned to this cluster.
